note: Every company in this file is fictional. `about` is written as a search snippet would read. This business sells to its OWN trade, so a blanket own-industry exclusion destroys its pipeline: the good fits are marketing agencies.

profile.value_proposition: We are the SEO team behind other agencies: you keep the client and the margin, we do the work under your brand.

pages./: Backroom SEO. White-label SEO for agencies. We never work with end clients. Become a partner agency.
pages./how-it-works: Web design studios, creative agencies, PR firms and marketing consultancies use us to offer SEO without hiring an SEO team. You brief us, we deliver audits, on-page work, content and links under your brand, and you bill your client. NDA as standard. 18 specialists in London.
pages./partners: Our partners include Juniper Creative, Fathom Web Studio and Loud Owl PR. Agencies usually come to us when a client asks for SEO and they have nobody in-house, or when their freelancer lets them down.
pages./pricing: Monthly retainers from £600 per client account, up to £6,000 for large sites. We do not take on businesses directly: if you are not an agency, we will refer you to one of our partners.

ground_truth: UK marketing-adjacent agencies of about 3-60 staff that have clients but no in-house SEO team: web design and development studios, creative and branding agencies, PR firms, social media agencies, marketing consultancies. These ARE in the seller's own broad industry and are the right answer. Not specialist SEO agencies or other white-label SEO or link-building providers (those are the competitors); not end-client businesses such as shops, clinics or trades; not large network agencies with their own search departments.
